title: Version history
idea: Version history: Named checkpoints and diff previews support safe restoration
audience: People who need to restore version within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic timeline layout through its restore version priority and explicit commitment contract: Restoring creates a recoverable new checkpoint
navigation: Version history keeps the current restore version context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Named checkpoints and diff previews support safe restoration
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to restore version; users recover earlier document states
composition.priority: Restoring creates a recoverable new checkpoint

imagery.role: Support the actual restore version context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep current and proposed state identities visible
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the version history structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no restore version content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Restoring creates a recoverable new checkpoint
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized restore version content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Restoring creates a recoverable new checkpoint
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active restore version context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
